campaigns.rationale: English demand for the two highest-ticket products ABK stocks: Vertek Weather Armor paint protection film and Vertek window film. It is isolated from every other theme because this is where service intent is most poisonous - someone searching window tinting in Qatar wants a workshop, and ABK is not one - so it needs its own negative wall, product-qualifier-only keywords, and copy that says out loud that the customer's own fitter applies the film.

notes:
PRE-IMPORT CHECKLIST - ppf-tint

1. THE BRIEF I WAS GIVEN IS OUT OF DATE. READ THIS FIRST.
 My theme brief named five VTEK SKUs: Weather Armor ULTIMATE, PRO, MATTE, PRISM and Solar
 Armor tints. NONE of them exist in the deployed catalogue. catalogue.json is now generated
 from "git show HEAD:src/data/products.ts (what is actually deployed)" and the live PPF/tint
 range is exactly TWO products:
 - vertek-ppf-weather-armor (brand "Vertek", gloss / matte, one SKU)
 - vertek-window-tints (brand "Vertek", multiple VLT grades, one SKU)
 Everything the brief promised as copy fuel - 8.5 mil / 215 micron, Advanced Polycarbonate
 TPU, 10-year manufacturer warranty, hydrophobic top-coat, PRISM colours (Nardo Grey, piano
 black, pearl white), the Iconic & Indulge series, 65% TSER, 90%+ IR, 99% UV rejection -
 belongs to a product set that is NOT live. Every one of those claims has been removed. Four
 grade-specific URLs (…-ultimate, …-pro, …-matte, …-prism) and …/vtek-window-tints would all
 404 today and are not used anywhere in this file. A separate "Colour & Matte PPF" ad group
 was designed and then deleted for the same reason: PRISM does not exist.
 => IF the 5-SKU VTEK range is later deployed, this file must be rebuilt, not patched.

2. BRAND TOKEN RESOLVED: "Vertek". The open question in the research brief (VTEK vs Vertek) is
 settled by the deployed data - products.ts line 11 declares "Vertek", the product names read
 "Vertek PPF - Weather Armor", and llms.txt plus the Google Business Profile agree. All ad
 copy says Vertek, so ad and landing page match. "vtek ppf" and "v-tek ppf" are retained on
 the KEYWORD side only, to catch searchers who met the other spelling.

3. EVERY CLAIM IN THIS FILE TRACES TO THE LIVE PAGE.
 PPF page: self-healing nano-technology, scratch resistant, weather proof, high gloss,
 gloss / matte finishes, "cut for full-body, front-end, or custom areas", "Application =
 Fitted by a trained installer", "Available from our Mesaimeer store".
 Tint page: "cut heat, UV and glare without compromising visibility", "Multiple VLT grades",
 "Supplied cut to size", "lifetime peel warranty on the film".
 No thickness, no micron figure, no year-count warranty, no IR/TSER/UV percentage appears
 anywhere, because none of those numbers are on the live pages.

4. NO LEGALITY, VLT NUMBER OR PERMIT CLAIM IN ANY AD - DELIBERATE, AND IT NEEDS AN OWNER CALL.
 The live tint page does say "Compliant with Qatar regulations" and "grades to match Qatar's
 regulations". I did not repeat that in ad copy. Qatar restricts front glass, bans reflective
 film, and fines QAR 1,000 plus impound; public sources genuinely disagree on the current
 figure. A Google ad implying street-legality is both a policy risk and a real customer-harm
 risk. Tint copy sells heat, UV and glare rejection instead ("Heat Rejection, Not Dark").
 ACTION: have the owner confirm the current MOI limit in writing. If confirmed, a compliance
 headline can be added later; until then it stays out - and the LANDING PAGE claim should be
 reviewed too, since it is the stronger exposure.

5. ARABIC NEGATIVE MATCH TYPES ARE LOAD-BEARING. DO NOT "TIDY" THEM TO PHRASE.
 The best Arabic tint keyword is رول تظليل سيارات (tint roll). A PHRASE negative on
 تظليل سيارات would block it, because the product query literally contains the service
 phrase. That is why تظليل سيارات, تظليل, مخفي and مخفي سيارات are EXACT negatives, with
 phrase negatives reserved for unambiguous service strings (تركيب تظليل, محل تظليل,
 تظليل متنقل). Identical logic in English: "car tinting", "window tinting" and "tinting" are
 EXACT; "tinting service", "tinting shop", "tinting near me" are PHRASE.

6. WHY "service" AND "خدمة" ARE NOT BARE ACCOUNT NEGATIVES.
 The company is called ABK Trading & Service (للتجارة والخدمات). A bare negative on either
 word would suppress the brand's own searches account-wide. The shared list uses phrase forms
 ("tinting service", "خدمة تظليل") instead. Same reasoning for "installer": it is never a
 negative on its own, because "ppf supplier for installers" is a trade buyer and is bid as an
 EXACT positive. Only "installation" and "installer near me" are blocked.

7. THE HEAD TERM IS NOT BID. "paint protection film qatar", "ppf qatar", "window tint qatar"
 and "ceramic coating qatar" are absent from every keyword list on purpose. In Qatar those
 SERPs are owned by installers (Topaz, Al Muftah, Shield Tint, Prestige Auto Clinic) and the
 intent behind them is a workshop, not a purchase. Intent lives in the modifier - buy,
 supplier, roll, cut to size, wholesale - so the modifier is what is bid. Expect low volume
 and high relevance; that is the trade being made. Review search terms weekly for the first
 month and promote any product-intent variant that surfaces.

8. NO PRICE LANGUAGE, NO PHONE NUMBER IN AD TEXT. The site has no prices, so nothing here
 anchors one - no "from QAR", no cheapest, no discount, no sale. The phone number is
 deliberately absent from every description: Google disallows phone numbers in ad text. Add
 as a CALL ASSET. Final URLs must stay on abktradingservice.com - a wa.me link
 cannot be a Final URL because the display domain has to match - and each product page already
 carries the WhatsApp button that is the actual conversion.

9. BID STRATEGY. "Maximize conversions" is stated for consistency with the rest of the account,
 but with zero conversion history it will overspend on a QAR 45/day budget. Recommendation:
 launch on Maximize Clicks using each ad group's maxCpcQAR as the CPC cap, define the WhatsApp
 click and the contact page as conversions, then switch to Maximize Conversions after roughly
 30 recorded conversions.

10. GEO NEGATIVES WOULD BLOCK A FUTURE GCC CAMPAIGN. The shared list includes dubai, riyadh,
 kuwait city, manama and muscat to stop Qatar-targeted spend leaking. If the owner confirms
 ABK actually fulfils cross-border wholesale and a GCC campaign is built from the wholesale
 ad groups, those five must be removed from the shared list first or that campaign will never
 serve. (Whether ABK ships cross-border is still an open question in the research brief.)

11. SHOPPING IS NOT AVAILABLE IN QATAR. Merchant Center does not support Qatar, so there is no
 feed, no Shopping campaign and no feed-driven PMax for the B2C side. Search-only here is a
 constraint, not a preference.

12. AD SCHEDULE MATTERS MORE THAN USUAL. The conversion is a human WhatsApp reply. The store is
 shut 13:00-16:00 and all day Friday. The schedule pauses Friday entirely and brackets the two
 open windows with a 30-minute buffer. Widen it only if the owner actually answers WhatsApp
 outside store hours.

13. ARABIC WAS BUILT FOR RTL, NOT TRANSLATED FROM THE ENGLISH. No Arabic headline opens with a
 Latin token or a digit, none ends in punctuation, no em-dash or pipe appears in Arabic ad
 text, all tashkeel is stripped (each shadda would burn one of 30 characters), digits would be
 Western if used, and Latin brand tokens sit mid-string or terminal. Display paths are Latin
 only (ar-ppf, ar-tint, ar-wholesale). Still: paste every Arabic asset into Google's own ad
 preview before import - a monospace editor hides bidi reordering.

14. NOTHING HERE PROMISES A SERVICE. Copy was written against the banned list: no install, book,
 appointment, fitting, service, and no تركيب / خدمة / احجز / موعد. The honest position is
 stated outright in both languages - "We Supply, We Don't Fit" and نورد ولا ننافس ورشتك -
 which doubles as the B2B wedge against installing rivals who compete with the very shops they
 would sell to. "We do not tint cars" appears verbatim in a tint description.

15. ONE SKU DELIBERATELY LEFT OUT: autotriz-ppf-gel (PPF/tint slip gel, 20 L / 4 L, made in
 Germany) sits in the ppf category and is a genuine installer-supply product with a live page.
 It is not in this theme to avoid bidding against whichever campaign owns the Autotriz range.
 Whoever builds that theme should take it - "ppf slip solution", "tint application gel" and
 "autotriz ppf gel" are cheap, uncontested, and reach exactly the trade buyers this theme is
 also chasing.
